Olympia '25 prototypes prototypes prototype prototype prototype prototype Information Caroline Guitar Company Our Olympia™ Fuzz will be released in Fall 2011. Inspired by our favorite timeless and classic transistor-based fuzzes, we tweaked every component we could to squeeze as much performance as we could out of the designs, listened to what our testers and players told us, then forgot about the math and went for the red line. As Lemmy from Motorhead once sang: "You thought you knew the answers/but you only knew the rules." We named it Olympia in honor of its "hammer of the gods" '60s roots, the Pacific Northwest locales where this sound came back with a vengeance in the '90s, and the Columbia neighborhood that is now a home to our emerging musical and artistic scene. We are really looking forward to you getting to play this.
